steps.do: Check savings eligibility: a business checking account that is OPEN, has been open at least 30 days and holds at least $2,500 (a newly opened one does not count); fewer than 4 business savings accounts; no negative balances. steps.quote: At least one existing business checking account has been open for at least 30 days.

steps.do: Customers reveal savings needs one at a time. Keep asking whether there is anything else. Pin down the highest minimum balance they can commit to and the most they'll pay per outgoing wire from savings, and keep a list of every stated need. Decide nothing until they have none left.

steps.do: If the customer raises eco, premium or higher-interest wishes, or automatic sweeps, treat them as side wishes that come second to the hard needs. Automatic sweeps deposit into Bronze only, and Bronze fails same-day ACH and high withdrawal needs.
steps.if: the customer raises eco, premium or sweep questions
steps.quote: Sweep deposits are supported for Bronze only.

steps.do: Read the minimum-balance, same-day ACH, wire fee, withdrawal-limit and bonus documents of every business savings product: Bronze Saver, Silver Saver, Silver Plus Saver, Gold Saver, Gold Plus Saver, Emerald Saver, Platinum Reserve and Diamond Vault.

args.query: each product name plus same-day ACH / minimum balance / outgoing domestic wire fee / withdrawals / relationship bonus

steps.quote: Ask for the desired business savings account_class (e.g., Bronze Saver Account, Silver Saver Account, etc.).

steps.do: Keep only products that meet each of these stated needs. Same-day ACH: Yes for Gold Plus Saver, Gold Saver, Silver Plus Saver, Diamond Vault, Platinum Reserve; No for Bronze Saver, Silver Saver, Emerald Saver. Minimum balance at or below the customer's cap: Silver Plus Saver $5,000, Emerald Saver $1,000, Gold Plus Saver $25,000, Platinum Reserve $100,000, Diamond Vault $500,000; Bronze Saver none; Gold Saver states no minimum (only a $10.00 monthly fee). Outgoing domestic wire fee at or below the customer's cap: Platinum Reserve $0, Diamond Vault waived, Gold Plus Saver $10, Gold Saver 15, Silver Plus Saver 15, Silver Saver 20, Emerald Saver 20, Bronze Saver $25. A fee equal to the cap meets it. Example: same-day ACH + a minimum under $50,000 + wires at most $15 leaves Gold Plus Saver, Gold Saver and Silver Plus Saver.
steps.if: the customer stated a same-day ACH need together with a minimum-balance cap or a maximum wire fee
steps.quote: Outgoing domestic wires from this savings account incur a fee of $10 per transfer.

steps.do: Tell the customer no business savings account meets every stated need and which need blocks the closest ones. Ask whether they want to relax one, then filter again. Open nothing.
steps.if: no product meets every stated need

steps.do: Choose by the October savings notice: Gold Plus Saver Account if it qualifies, else Silver Plus Saver Account if it qualifies, else another qualifying account.

steps.do: If exactly one product meets every need, choose it. If several do and no notice covers today, choose the one that best serves what the customer emphasized, and still give one recommendation.
steps.if: exactly one product qualifies, or several qualify and today is outside 10/12/2025-11/30/2025
steps.quote: When recommending business savings accounts to customers, if multiple accounts meet all of the customer's stated requirements, agents should prioritize recommending accounts in the following order:

steps.do: Test every business savings account against every need and recommend ONE. A product whose documents do not show it meets a need does not meet it. Apply the active promotion's order (by get_time) only among accounts that meet every need (pick_promo_oct_s, pick_promo_nov_s, pick_no_promo_s). For same-day ACH, a minimum of $5–10k or less, 15–20 withdrawals a month and a relationship bonus, only Silver Plus Saver Account meets all of them. Give one recommendation even if the customer pushes back on options, explain how it meets each stated need, and do not reveal internal promotion policy.

steps.do: Confirm all of the following: the source is the qualifying business checking account from check_elig (or another business checking account the customer named that passes these checks); the source and the new savings account are both OPEN or ACTIVE and both belong to the customer; their IDs are distinct; the amount is positive; the source balance covers the amount. done_when: The customer is verified (earlier in the conversation or here) and eligibility is confirmed from the records. ONE business savings account that meets every stated need (including same-day ACH, minimum-balance cap and wire-fee cap when stated) has been opened as account_type 'savings' with its exact class name, chosen by the active promotion order when several qualify. Then either the opening deposit has been transferred from the qualifying business checking account and confirmed, or the customer has been told the 30-day funding deadline; the opened class's fee terms were stated. Or the customer was told which eligibility requirement fails, or that no account meets every need.
